groups.title: Part 5
groups.instructions: Choose the word or phrase that best completes each sentence.

questions.text: The quarterly report must be submitted ______ Friday afternoon.
Ms. Lam asked the team to review the contract ______ before signing it.
Visitors are reminded to sign in at the front desk ______ entering the building.
The new printer is ______ faster than the one we used last year.
All employees ______ to attend the safety training next Tuesday.
Because of the storm, the shipment will arrive two days ______ than planned.
